heapBenchmark.conditions: Four alternating fresh-process pairs per case. Timings include admission and sparse heap sampling. Diagnostic forced GC occurs before timing and after measured operations, never during them. Node kernel only; sampled heap is not an exact peak or Worker guarantee. Prior budget module uses current error dependency.

jsonBenchmark.boundary: Ordinary shapes are mixed; this is not a universal speedup. Prior size/encoding and budget modules run with current unchanged helper dependencies.

realFixture.scope: Alternating fresh Node processes; only the named module is replaced by the prior implementation, with current dependencies. Local 40,000-row many-page fixture query, not cloud throughput. Source store/runtime overhead excluded from pool metrics. Value parity is covered by external conformance; benchmark checks count and release.

nativeR2.boundary: Sparse GC-dependent samples are not exact peaks, statistical before/after heap proof, or a production Cloudflare cap.

rejectedPrototype: Unbound prototype methods improved timing but failed a detached-callback regression. Final lazy binding preserves that existing behavior. Earlier prototype measurements are not final-implementation evidence.
remaining: Whole-runtime headroom and other allocation categories remain open.
